description: Minimal managed lifecycle sequence. workflow run is read-only and returns the next host-owned action.

sequence.command: agent_lifecycle workflow run --state run.state.json --manifest plans/package/plan.manifest.json --operation-id managed-1 --expected-revision 1 --source-revision source
agent_lifecycle workflow task-start --state run.state.json --task WS-01 --operation-id task-start-1 --expected-revision 1 --source-revision source --reason launch

agent_lifecycle workflow task-result --state run.state.json --task WS-01 --operation-id task-result-1 --expected-revision 2 --source-revision source --result work/WS-01/attempt-1/task-result.json --reason done
agent_lifecycle workflow task-accept --state run.state.json --task WS-01 --operation-id task-accept-1 --expected-revision 3 --review work/WS-01/attempt-1/task-review.json --reason accepted

agent_lifecycle workflow finalize --state run.state.json --operation-id finalize-1 --expected-revision 4 --source-revision source --final-audit final/final-audit.json --proof final/proof.json --reason complete
